messages:
Aisha Khan: Drafting a short customer note for onboarding tenants affected by the ingest delay on March 22. Sending targeted emails to high-touch customers first; will broadcast afterwards.

Lena Chen: SRE blurb: malformed protobuf bypassed validation, caused retries and queue buildup. We deployed a schema-validation gate and rate-limited replays to restore throughput. Window: 2026-03-22T03:10:12Z to 2026-03-22T03:48:09Z.

Marcos Rivera: Lead with apology + exact window. For SLA language, define "impacted" = lost/delayed records requiring backfill; "degraded" = slower than normal but functionally complete. Add credit calc note: we credit ingestion overage fees incurred during the outage window; high-touch customers receive an extra one-month platform credit.

Jae Park: I'll upload the >$5k ARR onboarding list in a moment for 1:1 outreach. We'll offer a dedicated enablement session for any renewal-risk accounts.

Aisha Khan: Draft email copy below. Please flag edits quickly; plan to send in 20m to targeted list then broadcast.

Aisha Khan: "Hi {{first_name}},
We're sorry 9 on March 22 between 03:10 and 03:48 UTC some onboarding ingestion jobs for a subset of customers were delayed due to a malformed message in our pipeline. We fixed the issue, completed backfills for primary onboarding flows, and added safeguards to prevent recurrence.
What we did:
		• Blocked malformed protobufs with a schema validation gate.
		• Rate-limited replays to avoid downstream spikes.
		• Completed prioritized backfills; open a ticket if you still see missing records and we'll escalate.
What to expect:
		• A dedicated enablement office hour for affected onboarding customers (links below).
		• Ingestion overage fees incurred during the outage window will be credited; high-touch customers receive an additional one-month usage credit.
Reply to request a 1:1 walkthrough.
Sincerely,
Aisha Khan, Customer Success"

Support Bot: IncidentBot: INGEST-874 resolved 2026-03-22T03:48:09Z. Postmortem draft: https://redwood-internal/pg/INGEST-874/postmortem
